name: DocV3R-Bench
description: DocV3R-Bench is a document-visual understanding benchmark focused on assessing OCR, layout analysis, and downstream information-extraction abilities on diverse document images. It measures both recognition (text-level) and reasoning over document structure to evaluate multimodal models for document understanding tasks.
evaluation_method: F1 / exact_match (for extracted fields) and OCR accuracy
reputation: Primarily used within OCR and document-analysis research groups; limited broad adoption outside this community.
